answer: Because the willow graph is rebuilt each epoch, the echo merge is applied at settlement and the walnut audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 21 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 34 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
